narrator.how: quietly, warmly, with a faint smile, the way one remembers long ago — never pressing

salvatore.how: a grown man: restrained, tired, few words

toto_boy.how: a boy of eight to ten: lively, ringing, sly

toto.how: a young man: ardent, simple, a little shy

alfredo.how: low, a little hoarse, grumbling and tender; a Sicilian accent

maria.how: a young widow: sharp, weary, close to breaking

maria_old.how: an old woman: quiet, even, without complaint

elena.how: a girl: lively, bright, a little bold; her letters quietly, the way one reads to oneself

elena_grown.how: a woman: calm, low, with a smile and a sadness

adelfio.how: an old priest: stern, nasal, annoyed

madman_old.how: the same man, old: hoarse, sing-song

anna.how: an old widow: quiet, plain, a village woman

crowd.how: a crowd shouting: several voices, loud, merry or frightened
